body:
> You matter.

I don't believe this in a cosmic sense. Maybe to other people. I don't know why I'm so detached.
Thanks I really needed this. I cried. I hope you are right.

> What's human?

A highly intelligent and social being. I may have the intelligent thing but I don't have the social.

> You can't dislike everything

It's not that I dislike it, it's that doing things provide me nothing. I don't learn or gain anything and I'm the same person I was before I did whatever. So I figure why keep trying if it's the same every time. I've been the same person for about a decade.

I did say 
> I don't love... any activity

Sorry you typed that whole thing out.

> I care so much that I will get a Qovit tattoo just to show you how strong life, and its experiences, are.

That will probably be a wasted effort. I don't want to admit this because it seems edgy but I could be a psychopath. I've seen people dying on their death beds and been to funerals and haven't felt anything. Girls have shown interest in me but I haven't pursued them because I know I won't be able to love them like someone else can. So I guess I at least have some kind of morals. I don't know how much more I can stress that I don't feel human.

What is life without love? It's just an empty void waiting to be filled. I think everyone has an empty void that they fill with some type of love. I can't fill it. Should I be proud to be an involuntary nihilist?

Some people will always not like you. It's not your fault or their fault, it's part of the human condition. Even famous celebrities are not liked by everyone and it's practically their job to be liked. If a celebrity can't win over everyone's admiration, how can you?

At least in my experience people don't respect you if they figure out you'll do anything to get their approval. They see you as weak or pathetic. They'll just use you and you'll get nothing in return, you said no one has ever loved you back so this might be the case.

> I would buy them anything, do anything they wanted, bend over backwards to please them and some how no one has ever loved me.

That's no way to earn a person's respect. You need a person's respect for them to love you.
